speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; to help me identify the cause, how long has this been happening and does the vomiting occur after every feed?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus. This is a life-threatening surgical emergency indicated by bilious vomiting in a newborn, especially with a family history of pyloric stenosis and symptoms starting immediately after birth. Immediate surgical consultation and an abdominal X-ray are required.
